title: Marquis del Vasto to Charles V and the letter to "Garbino", 1527-28, BnF fr. 3022 nos. 6, 10, 20 (catalogue item 7)

steps.what: Fetched fr. 3022 (Gallica btv1b90601558) and identified the three catalogue pieces and folios.
Found no. 10 already solved by Lasry (2023) with Tomokiyo's edited text (2026), and Lasry's 2026 preliminary decryption of Cipher 2 covering no. 6 and no. 19.
Checked Lasry's no. 6 decryption against the f. 16v ciphertext (dʃfp = creo, nnbt = mas, qʃftxp = presto); identified no. 6 as del Vasto's own letter of early Dec 1527.

Identified about 40 b-/c-/d- code groups of no. 6 from context across nos. 6 and 19 (doz = Lautreque, deh = la Marca, dnb = dinero …) and made an edited reading (n6_reading.md); about 15 codes and some stretches open.
Transcribed no. 20 (1,315 groups) and ~2,600 groups of Ranzo's signed letters in fr. 2988; addition sheet transcribed (additione.json).
No. 20 code is initial letter + number, the number running in alphabetical order within each letter (solve.py, anchor.py).
Word annealer (solve2.py) on a held-out 3,900-word Castiglione control encoded the same way: ~46 % token, ~9 % type accuracy.
solve2.py on no. 20 + Ranzo: a stable function-word skeleton (che, il, per, non …) across six restarts; no content words.

Sought cribs: Clair. 327 and Clair. 314 copies (undeciphered), fr. 2988 other cipher pieces (a different French cipher), fr. 3019 no. 27 Ranzo letter (no decipherment), no duplicate text between no. 20 and Ranzo letters.
DECODE R1894 (catalogue 170) identified as the fr. 2988 Ranzo letter already transcribed; no key or decipherment on the record.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Estimate over nos. 6 and 20: no. 6 ~1,675 items valued by Lasry's decryption bar ~15 code groups and some stretches; no. 20 1,321 groups with no reading (the function-word skeleton not counted). Upper bound 1,675/2,996 = 0.56. No. 10 excluded (not worked here).

gaps.item: No. 20 (Madrid, 11 Apr 1528, to Garbino), whole letter
gaps.detail: Ranzo's code is non-alphabetical; the annealer recovers only function words on a matched control. Needs Ranzo's base table or a clear copy (Garbino's side, Spanish/Italian archives, Gattinara's papers).

gaps.item: No. 6: about 15 code groups and some '…' stretches
gaps.detail: Codes with one or no clear context (n6_reading.md).

outcome.notes: NOTES.md has no '## Remaining gaps' or '## Escalation' section; gaps sourced from its verdict table and the no. 20 section. NOTES and README call no. 6 'read', but no measured fraction exists for it; recorded here as read in part.

prior.where: cryptiana GL.htm: Lasry 2023 / Tomokiyo 2026 reading of no. 10; Lasry 2026 preliminary letter-level decryption of no. 6 (Cipher 2). Nothing for no. 20.
